name: com.donnyautomation/geocode-weather-search-markdown
description: Eight paid utilities for agents: forward and reverse geocoding, weather forecast, web search, URL-to-Markdown, cryptographic randomness, OFAC sanctions screening and GLEIF LEI lookup. USDC on Base via x402 — $0.003 per utility call, $0.03 for compliance data; you supply the wallet.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Base-mainnet buyer wallet private key (0x-prefixed). Fund with a few dollars of USDC on Base; needs zero ETH. Use a low-balance disposable wallet — this value sits in your client config in plaintext. Pays $0.003 per utility call, $0.03 per compliance call.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override of the gateway base URL. Defaults to https://x402.donnyautomation.com
